buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses a) Vendor Qualification Criteria: 1) Firm shall be OEM for the “PHOSPHOROUS BRONZE” mat erial. All the manufacturing facilities shall be in-house. Traders, dealers, stockiest, partnershi p firms (LLP) or channel partners etc. are not allowed to participate in tender. 2) The firm mus t be experienced supplier for “PHOSPHOROUS BRONZE” material. Firm shall submit copy of mi nimum 3 contracts in last 2 years for minimum order quantity of 500 Kgs Ph Bronze material f or each contract; failing which offer will be ignored. b) Firm has to supply the store as per Technical Specifications and Scope of work. The Qty s upplied shall be in minimum 2 Mtrs length tubes Or above for each tube, so that minimum nu mber of Test pieces/Samples will be required to be drawn for Material Testing. c) Qty Tolerance of +/-5% is allowed in total weight. The firm shall submit invoice of actual supplied Qua ntity. d) Inspection will be done by CNA(OF) Pune or their nominated inspection agency. Firm shal l indicate preferred place of inspection in offer i.e. (A) Inspection at firm’s premises Or (B) Ins pection at MTPF Ambarnath. Following inspection process will be applicable. e) Inspection at firm’s premises:- 1. Firm shall submit QAP to MTPF Ambarnath for onward transmission & approval of CNA(OF) Pune. 2. Navy Inspector shall be informed to witness the manufacturing process physically/through VC and un dertaking sampling inspection of Qty produced as per Supply order Qty + additional Qty required for testin g 3. Testing to be done as per IS:28 standard at NABL accredited lab. Ref. no & date of Sample forwarding letter issued by Navy inspector, identification mark and Heat nos shall be mentioned in NABL TC. 4. Any additional test viz. UT/RT required by Navy inspector as per mutually agreed QAP shall be undert aken at NABL/Govt. approved LAB. 5. Firm shall supply material with identification mark stamped by Navy Inspector on each and every tub e. All tubes will be sealed/stamped by Navy inspector. Firm shall dispatch material with Navy inspection cl earance letter for dispatch. Payment will be processed after satisfactory ORI at MTPF Ambarnath by NAI A mbarnath. 6. Delivery Period: 90 days after receipt of vetted copy of Supply Order. f) Inspection at MTPF Ambarnath:- 1. Firm shall submit NABL TC for chemical and physical tests as per IS: 28 Grade II.

2. Inspection will be undertaken by NAI Ambarnath at MTPF Ambarnath for chemical, mecha nical tests as per IS:28 and UT tests. 3. Payment will be processed after successful inspection clearance by NAI Ambarnath 4. Delivery Period: 60 days after receipt of vetted copy of Supply Order. g) Option Clause: 50% Applicable h) EMD : 3% Applicable i) Performance Security Deposits: 3% applicable of S.O. value; Validity of PSD: 14 months from the date of final delivery; PSD should be submitted within 01 month after receipt of supply order. j) Guarantee/Warranty: Firm has to give Guarantee/Warranty Certificate. The item should be guarantee d for a period of 01 year. k) Techno commercial terms like specification, deviations, freight charges, insurance, taxes, duties & ot her expenses if any should be specifically indicated in the offer. l) In case, there is any amendment by Govt. in taxes/levies/duties the same will be reviewed and amend ment will be issued from time to time. m) Bidder must sign and stamp Scope of work and Buyer Added specific Terms & conditions page duly with acceptance remarks and upload the same along with the bid document failing which the offer may be ignored n) Note - Firm has to submit following Documents along with Bid - 1) Local Content Declaration form for the subject store against this customized Bid 2) Non-Disclosure Agreement on Firm's Letter Head . 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic NON DISCLOSURE DECLARATION CERTIFICATE (On Bidder Letter Head) to be uploaded with bid: 1. I M/s. NAME OF THE FIRM hereby declare that I shall not disclose the contract or any provision, specification, plan, design, pattern, sample or information thereof to any third party during and after expiry of Contract. 2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 4. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original

delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 6. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): CNA OF PUNE OR THEIR NOMINATED AGENCY AT FIRMS PREMISES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: MTPF REPRESENTATIVE AT AVNL MTPF AMBARNATH 7. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 8. Ration Item ATCs Demurrage charges In case the rejected items are not lifted by the firm within 48 hrs, the demurrage charges at the rate of 0.5% of total contract value will be charged per day. In case the items are not lifted within a month, the same will be destroyed by the station board of officers and no claim will be admitted.Demurrage charges. In case the rejected items are not lifted by the firm within 48 hrs, the demurrage charges at the rate of 0.5% of total contract value will be charged per day. In case the items are not lifted within a month, the same will be destroyed by the station board of officers and no claim will be admitted. 9. Ration Item ATCs Packing Material The items will be supplied by the successful bidder in its original packing material and the packing material will not be returned. Weight of packing material will not be included in quantity supplied and only net weight of the items will be counted. The packing should be of standardized weights of appropriate size. Item will not be accepted in non-standardized weights.Packing Material. Weight of packing material will not be included in quantity supplied and only net weight of the items will be counted. The packing should be of standardized weights of appropriate size. Item will not be accepted in non-standardized weights.
